collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen sings while working, and one evening a voice from across the stream sings back.

description_variants.description: An Isolan sings while working, and one evening a voice from across the stream sings back.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) sings while (he/she) works, loudly and badly. One evening a voice from the tribe's side of the stream sings back, just as loudly and just as badly.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They sing back and forth across the water until it's too dark to see. (name1) never finds out who it was. (He/she) doesn't try very hard to.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) stops at once and goes red under (his/her) mask. The next evening, (he/she) hums very quietly. The voice across the water hums back.
